protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. At affected revision 632336d414ef708a542377c1aa8d6fdb7c70a760, DeserializeMRReq accepts the two-byte path 7f 41 because the outer word count is one, then deserialize_symbolic interprets 0x7f as a 31-byte symbol and memcpy reads 31 bytes although only one path byte remains. Issue 53 documents the normal SendRRData call chain and an ASan global-buffer-overflow at this sink. CVE-2026-16013 is PUBLISHED, and the repository owner acknowledged the report and pushed the fix, so this is not a withdrawn or rejected advisory.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as 186ffccd18abdcaa255f1fcb42a1a57bd920e538. Reverse -S history identifies it as the first commit adding deserialize_symbolic and both unchecked declared-length copy loops. Commit 491dddf6b34ec66f01b6e1f4c2be248bca1568fe only converts the surviving symbol loop to unchecked memcpy during the BufReader refactor; it does not originate the flaw.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The BIC has the single immediate parent 2d6b8f3eaafde2e6090cf76966b3d338f7e2b4f6, whose cipepath.c and cipepath.h contain neither deserialize_symbolic nor symbol_size or the corresponding declared-length copy. The BIC diff adds the vulnerable parser and call from DeserializePadded.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed not applicable. The BIC is a single-parent public commit, GitHub reports no associated pull request, and no finer public member history is reconstructable. Although the commit is broad, it directly first-writes the vulnerable function, so the public commit itself is the atomic BIC.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed at the advisory's rolling-release revision. There are no repository tags or GitHub releases. The BIC is an ancestor of the explicitly affected commit 632336d414ef708a542377c1aa8d6fdb7c70a760, while the fix is not its ancestor.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed at commit granularity because this rolling-release repository has no tags or releases. Affected commit 632336d414ef708a542377c1aa8d6fdb7c70a760 is an ancestor of fix 886a4d090e1c5b0475f0b1c2fe0606a8f0d6a519, matching the CVE record's named patch and the owner's issue-closing statement.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix 886a4d090e1c5b0475f0b1c2fe0606a8f0d6a519. It replaces both unchecked symbolic memcpy-and-advance sequences with BufReader::get_bytes; that method checks requested count against the reader limit and throws on over-read, and DeserializeMRReq catches the resulting range error and rejects the request.
